summary: Rendering/configuration setup: allocates a 24-byte function-table substruct through the vtable allocator at this+0x4, stores it at this+0x1A0 and seeds slot 0 with nullsub_4. Validates the sub-mode at this+0x24 against the mode at this+0x20 (expected matches 1, 3, 4, or a minimum of 1 for higher sub-modes), setting obj+0x14 to 8 and invoking the virtual dispatcher on mismatch. Then selects the blit function installed at v1[1] from the blit type at this+0x28: 1 installs F_2DCopyDelegation and clears per-channel bytes in the buffer at *(this+0xC4) using an 84-byte stride; 2 installs sub_51C94F or F_2DBlitTextureCopy and calls TableInitWithArithmeticProgression; 4 installs sub_51C6E1 or F_2DBlitTextureCopy with the same table call; the fallback (this+0x28 equal to this+0x24) installs F_2DBlitTextureCopy. Sets this+0x64 to the selected channel mode, this+0x68 from the flag at this+0x4A or from this+0x64, and returns the mode.

local_names.this: configuration object holding mode, sub-mode, blit-type and channel-state fields
local_names.v1: allocated 24-byte function table substruct stored at this+0x1A0
local_names.obj: vtable object read from *(this+0) whose +0x14 slot receives the 8/25 state

operations.description: Allocate a 24-byte function-table substruct through the allocator function pointer at *(this+0x4) with request (1, 24); store the result at this+0x1A0 and clear slot 0 with nullsub_4

Compatibility dispatch: read the sub-mode at this+0x24 and validate it against the mode at this+0x20; the pair is accepted when this+0x20 equals 1, 3, or 4, or when this+0x20 is at least 1 for sub-modes above 5
On an incompatible mode/sub-mode pair, set the state slot obj+0x14 to 8 (obj being the vtable pointer read from this+0) and invoke the virtual dispatcher through it
Blit-function selection branches on the blit type at this+0x28: special cases for not-4 and not-1 and an explicit equals-2 test, with a fallback when this+0x28 equals this+0x24

For blit type 1, set this+0x64 to 1 and, when this+0x24 is 1 or 3, install F_2DCopyDelegation at v1[1]; then clear the channel-state bytes at *(this+0xC4) in an 84-byte stride for channels past the first while this+0x20 is greater than 1
For blit type 2, set this+0x64 to 3; when this+0x24 is 3 install sub_51C94F at v1[1] and call TableInitWithArithmeticProgression, and when this+0x24 is 2 install F_2DBlitTextureCopy at v1[1] instead
For blit type 4, set this+0x64 to 4; when this+0x24 is 5 install sub_51C6E1 at v1[1] and call TableInitWithArithmeticProgression, and when this+0x24 is 4 install F_2DBlitTextureCopy at v1[1] instead

Fallback path: when this+0x28 equals this+0x24, set this+0x64 from this+0x20 and install F_2DBlitTextureCopy at v1[1]; on a hard mismatch set obj+0x14 to 25 and invoke the virtual dispatcher, using its result
Finalize the active channel mode: if the flag byte at this+0x4A is set write 1 to this+0x68, otherwise copy this+0x64 into this+0x68
Return the resulting channel mode value (this+0x64 or the virtual-dispatcher result)
Invoked by sub_516C7B (00516C7B) during configuration setup

clean_pseudocode: case 1: *(this + 0x64) = 1; if (*(this + 0x24) == 1 || *(this + 0x24) == 3) v1[1] = F_2DCopyDelegation; clear_stride(this + 0xC4); break;
case 2: *(this + 0x64) = 3; v1[1] = (*(this + 0x24) == 3) ? sub_51C94F : F_2DBlitTextureCopy; TableInitWithArithmeticProgression(this); break;
case 4: *(this + 0x64) = 4; v1[1] = (*(this + 0x24) == 5) ? sub_51C6E1 : F_2DBlitTextureCopy; TableInitWithArithmeticProgression(this); break;
default: if (*(this + 0x28) == *(this + 0x24)) { *(this + 0x64) = *(this + 0x20); v1[1] = F_2DBlitTextureCopy; } else { *(*(this) + 0x14) = 25; result = (**(this))(this); }
